items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: Then from Toody Johnson I went with Toody Harris.

ctx.x: No, I want to see him if I get out there. Oh yeah. Well, Tut was a guitar player. Tut Johnson,

he was a guitar player. He was playing guitar. He had a fella by the name of Mal playing bass. Now I got killed. One night, we was coming from White Castle. A fella dropped and ran into our car and hit the back wheel and turned us over. And, uh, turned us over three times in the middle of the street. And I was sitting right side of Mal. We was sitting on that side and I was sitting in the middle. And along the build tunnel and busted his bass all up. Killed him. Didn't kill him right. Then we take him to a black…
Then from Toody Johnson I went with Toody Harris. Now he was another singer. He didn't play nothing.
